title: オークスの後に・冠はなくとも

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove just misses out on winning the race, but…

text_block_list.name: Male Fan
text_block_list.text: You were great, Air Groove! Better luck next time!

text_block_list.name: Female Fan
text_block_list.text: You're still the new queen in our hearts, Air Groove! You'll do better in the next one!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: (It's a frustrating result, but my fans accept my performance anyway…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove is still so dignified!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I wonder if I could stand so proud after a disappointment?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: (As ever, people are always watching. Perhaps even more so after such a disappointing loss. I have to remember that.)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: (Which means I can't afford to be upset!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I apologize for failing to deliver a satisfactory result.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: This isn't the fault of your training. This is due to my own inadequacy. For that reason—
choice_data_list: Let's do even better in the Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yes. That was always my intent.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You really are ever the optimist. I should take a page out of your book.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Let's go. The final race of the Triple Tiara awaits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With her eyes on the final challenge, Air Groove ignites a new fire of motivation in her heart!
